title: SourceOS Confidential Compute Escalation
description: The tiered confidential-compute escalation contract (SourceOS-vs-Apple ModelCarry spec, section 5.2). Model execution escalates to a higher confidential-compute tier (e.g. on-device -> sealed enclave -> attested TEE) based on the data-residency / sensitivity class of the inputs. The escalation decision is governed and receipted: a request whose sensitivity class requires a minimum tier MUST run at or above that tier, and any tier that requires attestation MUST carry an attestation reference. Fail-closed is the core invariant: a request run below its required minimum tier is rejected, never silently downgraded. SHA-256 is the authoritative receipt-hash algorithm (FIPS 180-4).

belowMinimumTierIsRejected.description: Fail-closed core invariant. A request run at a tier below the minimum required by its sensitivity class MUST be rejected, never silently downgraded to a weaker tier.

unattestedTierRequiringAttestationIsReje.description: A decision that selects a tier which requires attestation MUST carry a non-null attestationRef; a missing attestation is a hard stop.

tierOrderingMustBeMonotonic.description: computeTiers MUST be ordered by strictly increasing rank. A non-monotonic ordering is non-conformant: the tier lattice must be totally ordered for a minimum-tier comparison to be meaningful.

computeTiers.description: The ordered confidential-compute tier lattice, weakest first. rank is strictly increasing in array order.

tierClass.description: The confidential-compute posture of this tier.

rank.description: Position in the tier lattice. Higher rank = stronger confidential-compute guarantee. Strictly increasing across computeTiers in array order.

requiresAttestation.description: Whether selecting this tier requires a non-null attestationRef in the decision.

attestationKind.description: The kind of attestation this tier's guarantee is anchored to. null/none for tiers that require no attestation.

sensitivityClassMap.description: Maps each data-sensitivity / residency class to the minimum confidential-compute tier permitted to process it.

dataResidencyClass.description: Residency posture required for this class, aligned with the estate InferenceReceipt dataResidencyClass vocabulary.

minimumTierRef.description: tierRef of the weakest tier permitted to process this class. A request in this class run below this tier is rejected.

decision.description: The governed, receipted escalation decision record.

requestSensitivityClass.description: Sensitivity class of the request being routed. MUST be present in sensitivityClassMap.

chosenTierRef.description: tierRef of the tier the request was actually executed on.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the escalation decision, propagated as first-class provenance.

attestationRef.description: Reference to the attestation evidence for the chosen tier. MUST be non-null when the chosen tier requiresAttestation.

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) of the decision receipt. Content-addressed; never null.
